reviews.title: Great air cooler, especially for the price.
reviews.comment: I’ve use 3 Z4Pro’s now and they’ve all worked flawlessly. The price has come down $5 recently. There’s only a couple options for air coolers under $20 and I’d only go with darkFlash. If they can keep this under $20 it’s gonna sell like crazy
reviews.author: melissa

reviews.title: Runs quiet and cool
reviews.comment: Runs quiet maintains my 9800x3d at 70c under stress. 1 exhaust and 6 inlet fans are also in the case.
reviews.author: DG

reviews.title: Very good but can be outstanding with a slight price adjustment
reviews.comment: It seems to be a good entry level cooler , it was easy to install and looks to be of reasonable quality - good for the price. It needs to be $4-$5 cheaper and it would turn to outstanding from very good
reviews.author: Gus Mondalek

reviews.title: Works Great
reviews.comment: It's solid, it's affordable. Haven't had any issues. Keeps it cool.
